        x = y1 - (b // a) * x1
        y = x1
        return gcd, x, y
    
    # CRT solver
    def crt(remainders, moduli):
        x = remainders[0]
        m = moduli[0]
        
        for i in range(1, len(remainders)):
            r = remainders[i]
            n = moduli[i]
            
            # Solve: x ≡ x (mod m) and x ≡ r (mod n)
            gcd, p, q = extended_gcd(m, n)
            
            if (r - x) % gcd != 0:
                return None  # No solution
            
            lcm = m * n // gcd
            x = (x + m * ((r - x) // gcd) * p) % lcm
            m = lcm
        
        return x % m
    
    result = crt(remainders, moduli)
    return float(result)
